answer: The strongest single control I know for this is architect licence hash with architecture board attestation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Faking 729 identities means 729 fresh proofs and 73629 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. The summit of the design is public, the vertex of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the canyon of honest work is what finally pays. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
